title: Matched Latin ending contexts tie while informative internal matches are sparse
statement: The original role-correct scores were calibrated on 48 UD Latin LLCT development charters and run without retuning on 51 independent test charters. With exact left matching, all 626 word-final us/um pairs tie for each tested score, including 75 singular masculine pairs sharing lemma, visible prefix and part of speech with nominative versus accusative endings. The inclusive position-aware cutoff accepts both sides of these ties. Only 32 nonfinal pairs are available, three after matching part of speech, case and number, and zero among test lemmas absent from train and development, so these arms abstain at the preserved 40-site minimum. All scoring gaps in pooled us/um runs come from the right direction, for which only 31–32 of 657–658 matched pairs differ. The pooled target ranks ahead of its decoy in all five repeats, but the strict position-info cutoff accepts neither. Across in/is and er/es, all three methods accept all ten planted targets and also accept five decoys at the frozen thresholds. The repeats share documents and are not independent. No manuscript candidates were tested.
check: Reproduce the disjoint charter splits, frozen calibration and held-apart assessment. Before reusing this family of scores, report the number of actual disagreements among matched exterior contexts, and separately quantify classification of planted alternatives and acceptance of standalone-letter nonreplacement controls. Source new documents with enough matched internal tokens for a balanced morphology-restricted test.

evidence.prior_context_source: position_context.py embedded in registry item P-L1-018

prior_replay.formal_launcher_verification: The bundled launcher verified the inputs and initial scripts and stopped at the calibration byte SHA mismatch. The original evaluation and verification scripts were then run without editing the published corpus, algorithms or thresholds.
prior_replay.scope: The archived evaluation contains additional negative-control details outside the compared summary. This distinguishes structured numerical reproduction and agreement of pairing, threshold and acceptance decisions from byte-for-byte identity.

split.dev: Calibrate thresholds using only the original Latin in/is and er/es decoys in the independently partitioned development charters.
split.test: Evaluate frozen thresholds on the separately partitioned test charters. Report overlaps at the charter level and keep the annotation source distinct from the manuscript.

design.threshold: Among common supported development runs, set each strict threshold to the empirical 5th-percentile order statistic of the decoy losses, as in PR 623. Score all test results without retuning. Show sensitivity and specificity and all abstentions. The five seeds reuse the same charter split and do not provide independent sampling units.

matching.all: Match initial and final flags and immediate left character, on orthographic surface tokens.
matching.terminal: Same matching restricted to terminal candidates.
matching.terminal_same_stem_case: Use only singular masculine nouns, adjectives and proper nouns. Pair final us (nominative) to um (accusative) with same prefix before ending, normalized lemma, part of speech, and initial status.
matching.internal: Use nonfinal candidates, with mass matched on left context and initial status. A nonfinal occurrence can still span a morpheme boundary.
matching.internal_same_morph: Use nonfinal candidates matched additionally on UPOS, Case and Number. Report comparable support before interpreting effects.
matching.internal_new_lemma: Use nonfinal test candidates from single-token lemmas absent in both training and development, as a declared sensitivity. A result can abstain from limited support.
matching.pair_exclusion: Two substitutions cannot be in the same surface word. This preserves outside characters at all planted positions. Match seed is a deterministic tie-breaker per stratum.

controls.both_sides_matched: A subset matched on both exterior characters gives identical lossy observables for the planted symbols. Report support, equality and any cutoff accepting both.
controls.negative: Run the same threshold on unaltered natural letters q, t, r and n when they are not the claimed components. Test against us, in and er. These are operational decoys, not proven historical simple letters.

design.prediction: Both-matched immediate contexts and left-matched word-final cases tie exactly wherever supported, independent of contextual grammar or morphology. A nonfinal difference may reflect lexical distributions. A case-labelled difference alone would not identify the historical composition of a written sign.
design.no_manuscript: No Voynich candidates evaluated and no hidden text used.

matched_contrast_support.rule: An exterior character that is equal within every matched pair gives no direct information for the ranking on that side. The guard shown here counts matched rows with distinct right characters and uses the earlier numerical 40-candidate cutoff as an illustrative pair-level requirement. It does not alter the calibrated decisions or justify a threshold for unpaired or manuscript data.

reproduction.python_runtime: standard library and vs.refcorpus from the project worktree for the verbatim prior module

scripts_as_text.contrast_support.py:
"""Describe how much of each matched contrast can change its contextual ranking."""
from collections import Counter
import json
from pathlib import Path

from charter_context import all_sites, make_pairs, planted_context, read_words


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TOL = 1e-10


def verify_gap(row, words, sites):
    matched, _ = make_pairs(sites, row["mode"], row["seed"], set())
    assert len(matched) == row["pairs"]
    context = planted_context(words, matched, row["target"], row["decoy"])
    candidate, control = context.all["X"], context.all["Z"]
    assert candidate["left"] == control["left"]
    left_match_counts = Counter((a.before, a.after == " ") for a, _ in matched)
    assert left_match_counts == Counter((b.before, b.after == " ") for _, b in matched)
    assert all(a.after == b.after for a, b in matched if a.after == " ")
    across = sum(a.after != b.after for a, b in matched)
    assert across == row["pairs"] - row["same_right_context"]
    from charter_context import prior
    right_reference = context.all[row["target"][1]]["right"]
    right_gap = (prior.js(control["right"], right_reference) - prior.js(candidate["right"], right_reference)) / 2
    baseline_gap = row["scores"]["Z"]["unconditioned"] - row["scores"]["X"]["unconditioned"]
    assert abs(baseline_gap - right_gap) < TOL
    return {
        "seed": row["seed"], "matched_pairs": row["pairs"],
        "exterior_right_differs": across,
        "right_contribution_to_decoy_minus_target_unconditioned_loss": right_gap,
        "illustrative_pair_count_guard_pass": across >= 40,
    }


def main():
    evaluation = json.loads((ROOT / "evaluation.json").read_text())
    words, _ = read_words("test")
    tests = {}
    for target, decoy in (("in", "is"), ("er", "es"), ("us", "um")):
        selected = [row for row in evaluation["rows"]
                    if row["target"] == target and row["decoy"] == decoy and row["mode"] == "all"]
        sites = all_sites(words, target, decoy)
        tests[f"{target}/{decoy}"] = [verify_gap(row, words, sites) for row in selected]
    negative = {
        method: {
            "supported": sum(row["scores"][method] is not None
                             for row in evaluation["negative_controls"]),
            "accepted": sum(row["acceptances"][method]
                            for row in evaluation["negative_controls"]),
        }
        for method in evaluation["thresholds"]
    }
    result = {
        "derived_after_evaluation": True,
        "rule": (
            "An exterior character that is equal within every matched pair gives no direct "
            "information for the ranking on that side. The guard shown here counts matched "
            "rows with distinct right characters and uses the earlier numerical 40-candidate "
            "cutoff as an illustrative pair-level requirement. It does not alter the "
            "calibrated decisions or justify a threshold for unpaired or manuscript data."
        ),
        "contrasts": tests, "standalone_letter_controls": negative,
    }
    (ROOT / "contrast-support.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

evidence.scope: Atomic replacement is planted, not an assertion about actual Latin writing. Ties are a consequence of the immediate exterior-context observables and their position strata. These comparisons cannot identify historical glyph composition. Word-internal forms may span a morpheme boundary. The annotated evidence comes from the charters. Natural single letters in the unedited text are operational no-replacement controls, not claims about their historical graphogenesis.

morphology_coverage_audit.scope: UD Latin LLCT test charters only. Support and concentration from the same frozen match, with no new scores. Counts per matched seed reuse source charters and are not independent observations.
